models: Esquire (the 'Born to Run' guitar, a hybrid Tele
guitar.evidence: Springsteen's battered Telecaster/Esquire hybrid is one of the most iconic guitars in rock, featured on countless album covers.

tone.target: jangly edge-of-breakup acoustic-electric strum with springy room
tone.profile: jangly edge-of-breakup acoustic-electric strum with springy room
tone.summary: Clean signal chain using a Boost/OD for initial sparkle, followed by US Deluxe amp modeling, Chorus for shimmer, and Spring Reverb in a small room setting.

rig.name: Bruce Springsteen - Thunder Road - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide a subtle lift and sparkle to the clean signal.
blocks.gap: The Boost module is used for gentle tone shaping rather than heavy drive, fulfilling the 'sparkly top' requirement.

blocks.purpose: Keep the signal clean and avoid mid-gain crunch.
blocks.gap: The 'None' setting is used to bypass any drive stage, maintaining maximum clarity for the acoustic strum feel.

blocks.purpose: Model a bright, clean Fender-style tone suitable for open chord shimmer.
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is the best fit for the required 'Fender-style clean' sound.

blocks.purpose: Provide a bright and articulate cabinet sound matching the US Deluxe amp model.
Add a subtle 'sparkle' and shimmer to the open chords.
blocks.gap: Chorus is used gently to enhance the 'jangly' quality without sounding artificial.

blocks.purpose: Enhance the high-end sparkle and cut unnecessary low-mids.
blocks.gap: Used for precise tonal sculpting to achieve maximum clarity.

blocks.purpose: Create the required 'small-room ambience' without sounding cavernous.
blocks.gap: Room reverb provides a natural, contained space that fits the song's intimate feel.

blocks.purpose: Keep the signal dry and focused on strumming rhythm.
blocks.gap: Delay is bypassed to maintain rhythmic clarity.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for a more authentic, open-air acoustic strum sound.

proposals.reason: The current US 2x12 is too defined; a more natural, open sound is needed for acoustic strum.
proposals.expectedGain: More organic and less boxy tone
